description: Coaching institute alleged advance knowledge of answer key. NTA denied. Legal challenge dismissed by court.
Supreme Court cancelled exam June 15. Bluetooth-vest cheating ring across 10+ states. 350+ mobiles seized. 6.3 lakh students retook exam.
legal_outcome: Full cancellation; SC order; operator Ravi Attri later linked to 2024 leaks
source: Supreme Court order AIPMT 2015; India Today June 2015

description: Tamil Nadu CB-CID and other state agencies arrested proxy candidates. Opposition parties cited 2016 in formal NEET controversy timeline.
legal_outcome: Affected center results invalidated; candidates debarred

description: 12 arrests for proxy candidates in Chennai centers. Exam held; affected center results invalidated.
OMR sheet manipulation alleged at multiple Rajasthan centers. CBI probe launched; 7 persons arrested. Results of affected centers re-evaluated.
Jaipur police arrested candidate Dineshwari Kumari and invigilator Ram Singh and 5 others post-exam. NTA dismissed pre-exam rumours but police confirmed localized breach. No full cancellation.
legal_outcome: Arrested and charged; localized breach confirmed

description: Multiple state-level cheating allegations. No confirmed national paper leak verified for 2023 specifically. Jharkhand trunk theft previously listed here is confirmed 2024 — corrected.
legal_outcome: Under investigation; reclassified from Major to Minor
source: CBI FIR date confirmation; multiple news sources

event_title: Grace mark scandal + Bihar paper theft
description: 67 perfect scorers (720/720) — statistical impossibility. CBI confirmed paper stolen from NTA trunk in Hazaribagh Jharkhand. 6 FIRs filed across Bihar Gujarat Rajasthan Maharashtra. SC refused full cancellation but ordered result revision for 1563 candidates.
modus_operandi: Paper theft from NTA storage + grace mark manipulation + solver gangs
legal_outcome: SC ordered result revision for 1563 candidates; CBI investigation ongoing
source: CBI FIR 2024; Supreme Court order Aug 2024; NDTV; Indian Express

description: 5 of 14 NTA exams faced disruptions per Parliament Standing Committee Dec 2025. NEET 2025 conducted with localized irregularities in 3 states. UGC-NET and NEET-PG cancelled separately.
modus_operandi: Multiple methods across different NTA exams
legal_outcome: Parliament committee review; NTA reform panel constituted

description: 410-question corpus leaked April 29 via Telegram. 135 verbatim matches confirmed by CBI. Multi-state mafia involving Rajasthan Bihar Maharashtra Kerala. Exam cancelled May 12 for 22.7 lakh. Re-exam June 21. Public Examinations Act 2024 invoked.
modus_operandi: Question bank theft from NTA pipeline + Telegram distribution + coaching operator network
legal_outcome: Full cancellation; CBI investigation; Public Examinations Act invoked; re-exam ordered
source: CBI FIR May 2026; NTA notification May 12 2026; The Hindu; Economic Times May 2026
